integrity: Finite classification uses integer hypergeometric coefficients and certified rational logarithm bounds. Independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Only finite census sizes up to 15, fixed equal species richness and total census, and sampling without replacement; larger-census reversals and sampling uncertainty are not classified. The complete 2014 methodological paper could not be inspected through available routes.
title: Fifteen individuals are sharp for two Shannon-rarefaction ranking reversals at fixed richness
